title: intervals: merge drops overlaps
summary: An interval-merging helper that loses ranges, which also corrupts a calendar free-slot finder built on it.

issue.title: merge_intervals() shrinks overlapping ranges and ignores touching ones
issue.body:
Calendar free-slot suggestions are wrong when meetings overlap.

merge_intervals([(1, 3), (2, 6)])
  got       [(1, 3)]
  expected  [(1, 6)]

merge_intervals([(1, 2), (2, 3)])
  got       [(1, 2), (2, 3)]
  expected  [(1, 3)]

total_covered([(0, 5), (3, 8)])
  got       5
  expected  8

The docstring says touching intervals merge and the result should cover the whole union. find_free_slots() inherits the bug and offers time that is actually booked.
